    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">用c语言手搓shellcode</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        要写一个能在 Windows 上的 Shellcode，最大的挑战在于 **PIC（Position Independent Code，位置无关代码）**。你不能硬编码 API 的地址（因为重启或不同机器上地址会变），也不能直接引用数据段的字符串和全局变量，全局变量依赖重定位表，Shellcode 没有这东西。所有数据必须在**栈（Stack）**上。更不能用库函数，因为代码没有导入表（IAT）。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="手搓shellcode">手搓shellcode</h1>
<p>为什么要用c语言搓个shellcode出来，为什么不用msfvenom？因为这玩意生成的shellcode是基于winsocket的，注进去还要启动个监听，我仅仅想要验证一下可行性而已，不如自己搓个弹出messagebox版本的shellcode</p>
<h2 id="环境">环境</h2>
<p>windows 11，amd64， 编译器用的x64 Native Tools Command Prompt for VS 2022（MSVC）</p>
<h2 id="原理">原理</h2>
<p>要写一个能在 Windows 上的 Shellcode，最大的挑战在于 <strong>PIC（Position Independent Code，位置无关代码）</strong>。你不能硬编码 API 的地址（因为重启或不同机器上地址会变），也不能直接引用数据段的字符串和全局变量，全局变量依赖重定位表，Shellcode 没有这东西。所有数据必须在<strong>栈（Stack）</strong>上。更不能用库函数，因为代码没有导入表（IAT）。</p>
<p>我们以 弹出MessageBox为例，需要解决四个主要问题：</p>
<ol>
<li>找到 <code>kernel32.dll</code> 的基地址</li>
<li>在 kernel32 中找到 <code>GetProcAddress</code> 和 <code>LoadLibraryA</code> 的地址</li>
<li>使用 <code>LoadLibraryA</code> 加载 <code>user32.dll</code>（MessageBox 在这里面）</li>
<li>解析出 <code>MessageBoxA</code> 的地址并调用</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="1找-kernel32dll-的基地址">1.找 <code>kernel32.dll</code> 的基地址</h3>
<p>我们利用 <strong>TEB (Thread Environment Block)</strong> 和 <strong>PEB (Process Environment Block)</strong> 来查找。</p>
<p><code>_WIN64</code> 和 32 位使用不同的寄存器：64 位：<code>gs:[0x60]</code>32 位：<code>fs:[0x30]</code></p>
<p>获取 <code>PEB</code>后，找到<code>peb</code>下的<code>Ldr</code>，再获取<code>InMemoryOrderModuleList</code>。链表顺序通常是: .exe -&gt; ntdll.dll -&gt; kernel32.dll. <code>LDR_DATA_TABLE_ENTRY</code> 结构体比较复杂，但在<code> InMemoryOrderLinks</code> 偏移处   <code> DllBase</code> 通常在 <code>entry </code>之后特定的偏移位置。  可以利用<code>CONTAINING_RECORD</code>的技巧或者直接偏移计算。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">HMODULE GetKernel32() {
#ifdef _WIN64
    PEB *peb = (PEB*)__readgsqword(0x60);
#else
    PEB *peb = (PEB*)__readfsdword(0x30);
#endif

    PEB_LDR_DATA *ldr = peb-&gt;Ldr;

    LIST_ENTRY *head = &amp;ldr-&gt;InMemoryOrderModuleList;
    LIST_ENTRY *entry = head-&gt;Flink;

    entry = entry-&gt;Flink;
    entry = entry-&gt;Flink;
    
    LDR_DATA_TABLE_ENTRY *ldrEntry = CONTAINING_RECORD(entry, LDR_DATA_TABLE_ENTRY, InMemoryOrderLinks);
    return (HMODULE)ldrEntry-&gt;DllBase;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2手动解析导出表">2.手动解析导出表</h3>
<p>获取 DOS Header 和 NT Header。从 OptionalHeader.DataDirectory 获取导出表 RVA。然后获取三个主要数组的地址（addressOfFunctions、addressOfNames、addressOfNameOrdinals），遍历 <code>AddressOfNames</code> 找函数名。使用 <code>ordinals</code> 和 <code>AddressOfFunctions</code> 得到函数实际地址。</p>
<p>其实就是等价于 Windows API 的 <code>GetProcAddress</code>，但是自己实现了，不依赖任何导入表。</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">FARPROC MyGetProcAddress(HMODULE hModule, const char *lpProcName) {
    PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)hModule;
    PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS nt = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS)((BYTE*)hModule + dos-&gt;e_lfanew);

    DWORD exportDirRVA = nt-&gt;OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_EXPORT].VirtualAddress;
    if (exportDirRVA == 0) return NULL;

    PIMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY exportDir = (PIMAGE_EXPORT_DIRECTORY)((BYTE*)hModule + exportDirRVA);

    DWORD *names = (DWORD*)((BYTE*)hModule + exportDir-&gt;AddressOfNames);
    WORD *ordinals = (WORD*)((BYTE*)hModule + exportDir-&gt;AddressOfNameOrdinals);
    DWORD *funcs = (DWORD*)((BYTE*)hModule + exportDir-&gt;AddressOfFunctions);

    for (DWORD i = 0; i &lt; exportDir-&gt;NumberOfNames; i++) {
        char *name = (char*)((BYTE*)hModule + names[i]);

        if (MyStrCmp(name, lpProcName) == 0) {
            WORD ordinal = ordinals[i];
            return (FARPROC)((BYTE*)hModule + funcs[ordinal]);
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}
</code></pre>
<p>这里因为不能依赖库函数，所以 MyStrCmp是自己实现的</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">int MyStrCmp(const char *s1, const char *s2) {
    while (*s1 &amp;&amp; (*s1 == *s2)) {
        s1++;
        s2++;
    }
    return *(const unsigned char*)s1 - *(const unsigned char*)s2;
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3entrypoint">3.EntryPoint</h3>
<p>首先函数名和 DLL 名手动写成 char 数组，避免直接引用字符串。获取 Kernel32 基址，再获取 GetProcAddress 函数指针、获取 LoadLibraryA 和 ExitProcess 函数指针，就可以加载 user32.dll， 获取 MessageBoxA 函数指针了</p>
<pre><code class="language-c">void EntryPoint() {

    char sLoadLib[] = {'L','o','a','d','L','i','b','r','a','r','y','A',0};
    char sGetProc[] = {'G','e','t','P','r','o','c','A','d','d','r','e','s','s',0};
    char sExit[]    = {'E','x','i','t','P','r','o','c','e','s','s',0};
    char sUser32[]  = {'u','s','e','r','3','2','.','d','l','l',0};
    char sMsgBox[]  = {'M','e','s','s','a','g','e','B','o','x','A',0};
    char sText[]    = {'H','e','l','l','o',' ','F','r','o','m',' ','C',0};
    char sTitle[]   = {'T','e','s','t','.',0};


    HMODULE hKernel32 = GetKernel32();

    P_GetProcAddress pGetProcAddress = (P_GetProcAddress)MyGetProcAddress(hKernel32, sGetProc);

    if (!pGetProcAddress) return;

    P_LoadLibraryA pLoadLibraryA = (P_LoadLibraryA)pGetProcAddress(hKernel32, sLoadLib);
    P_ExitProcess pExitProcess   = (P_ExitProcess)pGetProcAddress(hKernel32, sExit);

    HMODULE hUser32 = pLoadLibraryA(sUser32);

    P_MessageBoxA pMessageBoxA = (P_MessageBoxA)pGetProcAddress(hUser32, sMsgBox);


    if (pMessageBoxA) {
        pMessageBoxA(NULL, sText, sTitle, MB_OK);
    }


    if (pExitProcess) {
        pExitProcess(0);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="编译">编译</h2>
<p>编译shellcode，这里建议开启O1优化把函数内联进去</p>
<pre><code>cl.exe /c /nologo /Gy /O1 /GS- /Tc shellcode.c /Fo:shellcode.obj
</code></pre>
<p>链接shellcode</p>
<pre><code> link.exe /nologo /ENTRY:EntryPoint /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS /NODEFAULTLIB /ALIGN:16 /ORDER:@order.txt shellcode.obj /OUT:shellcode.exe
</code></pre>
<p>注意这里因为shellcode必须要保证入口函数偏移为0，所以要指定函数的顺序（order.txt）</p>
<p>我采用的顺序如下：</p>
<pre><code>EntryPoint
GetKernel32
MyGetProcAddress
MyStrCmp
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3540252/202603/3540252-20260306001326589-1173455320.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这里虽然error但是其实在用户态，shellcode.exe就已经可以执行了</p>
<p>然后把shellcode.exe的.text段抠出来，这里我们用python比较方便</p>
<pre><code class="language-python">import pefile 
import os

def extract_shellcode(file_path, out_file="shellcode.bin"):
    try:
        pe = pefile.PE(file_path)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"Error: File '{file_path}' not found!")
        return
    except pefile.PEFormatError as e:
        print(f"Error: Invalid PE file: {e}")
        return
    

    shellcode = b""
    for section in pe.sections:
        if b".text" in section.Name:
            shellcode = section.get_data()
            break
            
    if not shellcode:
        print("Error: .text section not found!")
        return
    
    print(f"Shellcode Length: {len(shellcode)} bytes\n")
    

    c_array = ''.join(f"\\x{byte:02x}" for byte in shellcode)
    print(f"// C String Format:\n\"{c_array}\"")
    

    print("\n// Hex Format:")
    print(shellcode.hex())
    

    try:
        with open(out_file, "wb") as f:
            f.write(shellcode)
        print(f"\nShellcode written to '{out_file}'")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error writing shellcode to file: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    exe_path = "shellcode.exe" 
    out_path = "shellcode.bin"  
    extract_shellcode(exe_path, out_path)
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3540252/202603/3540252-20260306001356051-1972143260.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>就得到了hex串</p>
<h2 id="执行">执行</h2>
<p>然后简单写个加载器试试</p>
<pre><code class="language-c++">#include &lt;windows.h&gt;
#include &lt;iostream&gt;
#include &lt;vector&gt;

int main() {
    unsigned char shellcode[] = 
        "";


    void* exec_mem = VirtualAlloc(0, sizeof(shellcode), MEM_COMMIT | MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_READWRITE);

    if (exec_mem == NULL) {
        std::cerr &lt;&lt; "[-] VirtualAlloc failed." &lt;&lt; std::endl;
        return -1;
    }

    std::cout &lt;&lt; "[+] Memory allocated at: 0x" &lt;&lt; exec_mem &lt;&lt; std::endl;

  
    memcpy(exec_mem, shellcode, sizeof(shellcode));
    std::cout &lt;&lt; "[+] Shellcode copied to memory." &lt;&lt; std::endl;


    DWORD oldProtect = 0;
    BOOL vpResult = VirtualProtect(exec_mem, sizeof(shellcode), PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &amp;oldProtect);

    if (!vpResult) {
        std::cerr &lt;&lt; "[-] VirtualProtect failed." &lt;&lt; std::endl;
        return -1;
    }
    std::cout &lt;&lt; "[+] Memory protection changed to RX (Read/Execute)." &lt;&lt; std::endl;


    std::cout &lt;&lt; "[*] Executing shellcode..." &lt;&lt; std::endl;
    

    ((void(*)())exec_mem)();

    VirtualFree(exec_mem, 0, MEM_RELEASE);

    return 0;
}
</code></pre>
<p>这里使用<code>VirtualProtect</code>赋予可执行权限，不然 <code>VirtualAlloc</code>的东西其实是在堆上的，无法执行。</p>
<p>然后把loader编译</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3540252/202603/3540252-20260306001407708-324637865.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>看到也是成功弹出来messagebox啦</p>
